name: bee-side
source:
Bee-Side is following Sunni who's determined to become an idol alongside her girlfriend, Bee. Help Sunni down the best path, whether it's becoming an idol herself or supporting Bee. There are currently 4 endings, with more planned in the future.

[From [url=https://monodygames.itch.io/bee-side]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Bee-Side正在追随Sunni，她决心与女友Bee一起成为偶像。帮助逊尼派走上最好的道路，无论是成为自己的偶像还是支持Bee。目前有4个结局，未来还会有更多结局。

[来自[url=https://monodygames.itch.io/bee-side]Itch.io[/url]]
